gap: The pricing page has page-level horizontal overflow on mobile: at a 390px viewport the document renders 516px wide (full-page capture is 1032px @2x vs Wave's 780px), so the whole page pans sideways, the light-blue Compare section stops three-quarters across the screen, and the header/hero/cards sit left-anchored with a dead cream strip on the right. The comparison table's swipe container is escaping its section instead of scrolling inside it. Constrain that scroller (its own overflow-x:auto wrapper at max-width:100%, no min-width leaking to an ancestor, section background full-bleed) so document scrollWidth equals 390 at that viewport.
